title: Machine Elements — 12-Mark Preparation
note: Original ACADRIX practice questions based on the R-2025 Unit IV syllabus. These are not claimed to be official university questions or PYQs.

questions.question: Explain the purpose of gears and classify the major types of gears based on shaft arrangement and tooth geometry. Discuss suitable applications of each type.
solutionPlan: Define gear and positive power transmission.
Classify spur, helical, bevel, worm and related gear arrangements.
Explain shaft arrangement and tooth characteristics.
Give suitable mechanical applications.

questions.question: Explain the function of bearings in rotating machinery. Classify bearings and compare sliding-contact and rolling-contact bearings with suitable applications.
solutionPlan: Define bearing and its role in supporting shafts.
Explain sliding and rolling contact principles.
Compare load capacity, friction, lubrication and applications.
Give examples of common bearing types.

questions.question: Explain the function and design considerations of shafts used for power transmission. Discuss the principal loads acting on a shaft and the factors considered in shaft selection.
solutionPlan: Define shaft and distinguish it from an axle where relevant.
Identify torque, bending and other service loads.
Discuss strength, stiffness, material, speed and fatigue considerations.
Explain practical shaft-selection criteria.

questions.question: Explain the purpose of mechanical fasteners and classify common fastening methods. Compare threaded fasteners with permanent joining methods in terms of assembly, maintenance and application.
solutionPlan: Define fastening and mechanical joints.
Explain bolts, nuts, screws and related threaded fasteners.
Compare detachable and permanent joining concepts.
Discuss selection based on load, maintenance and service conditions.

questions.question: Explain the purpose of shaft couplings. Classify rigid and flexible couplings and discuss their working principles, advantages, limitations and applications.
solutionPlan: Define coupling and its role in connecting shafts.
Explain rigid coupling and flexible coupling concepts.
Discuss misalignment accommodation, torque transmission and vibration.
Give representative applications and selection considerations.

questions.question: Explain the systematic procedure for selecting a machine component for a given engineering application. Discuss load, speed, material, environment, reliability, maintenance and cost as selection factors.
solutionPlan: Define the functional requirement.
Identify operating loads, speed and service conditions.
Evaluate material, size, reliability, safety and maintenance requirements.
Compare alternatives and justify the final selection.

questions.question: A power-transmission system requires speed and torque conversion between two shafts. Explain how you would select a suitable gear arrangement and discuss the factors affecting the choice.
solutionPlan: Identify input/output speed and torque requirements.
Determine shaft arrangement and required speed ratio.
Compare suitable gear types.
Consider load, efficiency, noise, lubrication, space and cost.

questions.question: Explain a practical bearing-selection procedure for a rotating shaft. Discuss radial and axial loads, speed, lubrication, operating environment, life and maintenance requirements.
solutionPlan: Identify radial and axial loading.
Determine speed and service conditions.
Select an appropriate bearing family.
Consider lubrication, temperature, contamination, life and maintenance.
Verify suitability before final selection.

questions.question: Explain the role of quality control in the manufacture and use of machine elements. Discuss inspection, dimensional accuracy, material quality, functional testing and corrective action.
solutionPlan: Define quality control and its purpose.
Explain incoming-material and dimensional inspection.
Discuss process and functional checks.
Explain defect identification, corrective action and documentation.

questions.question: Discuss safety considerations in the design, selection and operation of machine elements. Explain how proper component selection, guarding, maintenance and inspection reduce mechanical hazards.
solutionPlan: Identify common mechanical hazards.
Relate safe design and component selection to hazard reduction.
Explain guarding, lubrication, inspection and preventive maintenance.
Discuss safe operation and failure prevention.

questions.question: Compare gears and bearings as machine elements in terms of their primary functions, loading, operating requirements, lubrication and common failure concerns.
solutionPlan: State the primary function of each component.
Compare transmitted/contact loads and operating conditions.
Discuss lubrication and alignment requirements.
Explain typical failure mechanisms and maintenance needs.

questions.question: Explain how a shaft, coupling and bearings work together in a rotating power-transmission system. Describe the role of each component and the consequences of incorrect selection or alignment.
solutionPlan: Describe the power flow through the system.
Explain shaft, coupling and bearing functions.
Discuss alignment and load-transfer requirements.
Explain effects of unsuitable components, imbalance and misalignment.

questions.question: For a rotating mechanical drive, develop a component-selection strategy covering gears, shafts, bearings, fasteners and coupling. Explain how the components should be selected as an integrated system.
solutionPlan: Define the drive requirements.
Select the transmission arrangement.
Size/select shaft and bearings for the resulting loads.
Choose coupling and fastening arrangements.
Check compatibility, safety, reliability and maintainability.

questions.question: Explain how design, quality control, inspection and maintenance work together to prevent failure of machine elements. Illustrate the approach using gears, bearings or shafts.
solutionPlan: Identify possible failure causes.
Use suitable design margins and component selection.
Apply manufacturing quality control and inspection.
Use lubrication, monitoring and preventive maintenance.
Explain feedback and corrective action.

questions.question: Explain the major machine elements covered in the unit—gears, bearings, shafts, fasteners and couplings—and show how their selection contributes to safe, reliable and efficient machine operation.
solutionPlan: Define the purpose of each machine element.
Explain selection and operating considerations for each.
Relate the elements within a complete machine system.
Conclude with quality, safety, reliability and maintenance considerations.
